root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure unconditionally polled Unified Brain Delivery for an exact-head pull_request run, while unified-brain-delivery.yml is workflow_dispatch-only. The requested event can never exist, so terminal closure waits until timeout despite Required, Skill Projection and CodeQL being green.
fix: Make terminal critical-gate evaluation trigger-aware. Before polling Unified Brain Delivery for a pull_request run, inspect its workflow definition; when no pull_request trigger exists, emit explicit NOT_APPLICABLE evidence instead of polling an impossible event.
prevention: Never poll a workflow event that its trigger definition cannot emit.
Mark structurally impossible gates NOT_APPLICABLE with explicit evidence; never synthesize success.
All genuinely applicable Required, CodeQL, learning/skill and provider/readback gates remain fail-closed.

evidence.stuck_step: Verify exact-head critical delivery gates before terminal claim
